text:
Checkout said approved. The customer got email. The merchant's balance never moved.

Support: authorized yes, captured no. Card hold on the customer; our ledger and the payment service provider settlement file did not agree.

New case study: authorize vs capture APIs, wallet vs append-only ledger, idempotency keys on both steps, and daily reconciliation.
